ex.en: We have a verbal agreement, but nothing in writing.
ex.zh: 我們有口頭協議，但沒有書面文件。

ex.en: He received a verbal warning from his manager.
ex.zh: 他被主管口頭警告。

ex.en: I don't need your verbal gentleness.
ex.zh: 我不需要你嘴上的溫柔。

ex.en: She has excellent verbal skills.
ex.zh: 她的語言表達能力很好。

vend.zh: 販賣（常見於 vending machine 自動販賣機）

ex.en: This vending machine isn't working.
ex.zh: 這台自動販賣機壞了。

ex.en: The vending machines are over there.
ex.zh: 自動販賣機在那邊。

ex.en: They installed a vending machine at work.
ex.zh: 他們在公司裝了一台自動販賣機。

vend.en: to sell goods, especially from a coin-operated machine

ex.en: Draw a vertical line down the middle of the page.
ex.zh: 在頁面中間畫一條垂直線。

ex.en: The cliff is almost vertical.
ex.zh: 這座懸崖幾乎是垂直的。

ex.en: The President of the United States has the power to veto and send back legislation.
ex.zh: 美國總統有權否決法案並將其退回。

ex.en: The board vetoed the proposal.
ex.zh: 董事會否決了這項提案。

veto.en: to officially refuse to approve a plan or law

ex.en: The manager has a veto over all hiring decisions.
ex.zh: 經理對所有聘用決定都有否決權。

ex.en: Each member has the right of veto.
ex.zh: 每位成員都有否決權。

veto.en: the power or act of officially refusing to approve a plan or law

ex.en: You need to reverse your vest, it's back to front.
ex.zh: 你的背心穿反了，前後顛倒了。

ex.en: Life vests are located under your seats.
ex.zh: 救生衣在您的座位底下。

ex.en: He pinned the badge on his vest.
ex.zh: 他把徽章別在背心上。

vest.en: a piece of clothing without sleeves worn over a shirt

vest.zh: 授予（權力）；（股票選擇權等）歸屬、生效

ex.en: The board is vested with the power to hire the CEO.
ex.zh: 董事會被授予聘任執行長的權力。

ex.en: Your stock options will vest after three years.
ex.zh: 你的員工認股權三年後才會生效。

vest.en: to give someone legal power or rights, or to become fully owned by a person

ex.en: A vector is a unit vector if its norm is 1.
ex.zh: 範數為 1 的向量稱為單位向量。

ex.en: A vector has both size and direction.
ex.zh: 向量同時具有大小和方向。

vector.en: a quantity with both size and direction

ex.en: Mosquitoes are a vector for many diseases.
ex.zh: 蚊子是許多疾病的傳播媒介。

ex.en: Email remains a common vector for cyberattacks.
ex.zh: 電子郵件仍是網路攻擊的常見途徑。

vector.en: a living thing or path that carries a disease or attack to other targets

ex.en: English is a very important language in today's world.
ex.zh: 英語在當今世界是非常重要的語言。

ex.en: He would be very glad to hear the news.
ex.zh: 他聽到這個消息一定會很高興。

ex.en: This is the very book I was looking for.
ex.zh: 這正是我在找的那本書。

ex.en: At that very moment, the phone rang.
ex.zh: 就在那一刻，電話響了。

very.en: used to stress that you mean exactly that person or thing

ex.en: The input method also works with this version.
ex.zh: 這個輸入法也適用於這個版本。

ex.en: I've heard the French version of this song.
ex.zh: 我聽過這首歌的法文版。

ex.en: This dictionary isn't the most recent version.
ex.zh: 這本字典不是最新版。

version.en: a particular form of something that differs from earlier or other forms

ex.en: They gave different versions of the accident.
ex.zh: 他們對這起事故有不同的說法。

ex.en: I don't believe Tom's version of the story.
ex.zh: 我不相信湯姆的說法。

version.en: one person's account of an event

ex.en: The number of motor vehicles in the city has increased.
ex.zh: 市區的機動車輛數量增加了。

ex.en: Lightning struck the vehicle.
ex.zh: 閃電擊中了那輛車。

ex.en: Please do not leave your vehicle unattended.
ex.zh: 請勿將車輛留置無人看管。

vehicle.en: a machine, such as a car or bus, that carries people or goods on land

ex.en: Music is a powerful vehicle for expressing feelings.
ex.zh: 音樂是表達情感的有力媒介。

ex.en: Social media is an important vehicle for marketing.
ex.zh: 社群媒體是重要的行銷工具。

vehicle.en: a means by which something is expressed or achieved

ex.en: We bought some vegetables and fish at the market.
ex.zh: 我們在市場買了一些蔬菜和魚。

ex.en: Fruits and vegetables are essential to a balanced diet.
ex.zh: 蔬果是均衡飲食不可或缺的。

ex.en: The price of vegetables varies from day to day.
ex.zh: 蔬菜價格每天都在變。

vegetable.en: a plant or part of a plant eaten as food, such as a carrot or potato

ex.en: Who will provide capital for the venture?
ex.zh: 誰會為這項事業提供資金？

ex.en: They started a joint venture in Vietnam.
ex.zh: 他們在越南成立了一家合資企業。

venture.en: a new business or project that involves risk and may make money or fail

ex.en: Nothing ventured, nothing gained.
ex.zh: 不入虎穴，焉得虎子。

ex.en: We ventured out into the rain to buy food.
ex.zh: 我們冒雨出門去買食物。

venture.en: to go somewhere or do something that is risky or dangerous

ex.en: She is a veteran of the advertising industry.
ex.zh: 她是廣告業的老手。

ex.en: He's a 20-year veteran of the company.
ex.zh: 他在公司待了 20 年，是資深員工。

veteran.en: a person who has a lot of experience in a particular job or activity

ex.en: Tom is a Vietnam veteran.
ex.zh: 湯姆是越戰退伍軍人。

ex.en: The city held a ceremony to honor its veterans.
ex.zh: 市政府舉辦典禮表揚退伍軍人。

veteran.en: a person who has served in the armed forces, especially in a war

ex.en: A veteran reporter covered the story.
ex.zh: 一位資深記者負責報導這則新聞。

ex.en: The team is led by a veteran coach.
ex.zh: 這支球隊由一位經驗豐富的教練帶領。

veteran.en: having a lot of experience in a particular job or activity

ex.en: The cargo vessel arrived at the port this morning.
ex.zh: 那艘貨船今天早上抵達港口。

ex.en: Several fishing vessels were damaged in the storm.
ex.zh: 好幾艘漁船在暴風雨中受損。

ex.en: Exercise keeps your blood vessels healthy.
ex.zh: 運動能讓血管保持健康。

ex.en: A blood vessel in his eye burst.
ex.zh: 他眼睛裡有一條血管破了。

vessel.en: a narrow tube in the body that carries blood

ex.en: Store the oil in a clean glass vessel.
ex.zh: 把油存放在乾淨的玻璃容器裡。

ex.en: This ancient vessel was used for storing wine.
ex.zh: 這個古老的器皿是用來裝酒的。

vessel.en: a container for holding liquids, such as a bowl or bottle

ex.en: A sentence normally has a subject and a verb.
ex.zh: 一個句子通常有主詞和動詞。

ex.en: I don't like learning irregular verbs.
ex.zh: 我不喜歡背不規則動詞。

ex.en: This verb is normally used only in the third person.
ex.zh: 這個動詞通常只用在第三人稱。

verb.en: a word that shows an action, an event or a state

ex.en: The island is covered in thick vegetation.
ex.zh: 這座島上草木茂密。

ex.en: There is very little vegetation in the desert.
ex.zh: 沙漠裡幾乎沒有什麼植物。

vegetation.en: the plants that grow in a particular place

ex.en: When he shouted, the veins in his neck stood out clearly.
ex.zh: 他大吼的時候，脖子上青筋暴露。

ex.en: The nurse took blood from a vein in my arm.
ex.zh: 護理師從我手臂的靜脈抽血。

vein.en: a tube that carries blood to the heart from other parts of the body

ex.en: The rest of the speech continued in the same vein.
ex.zh: 演講的其餘部分延續同樣的風格。

ex.en: He spoke in a more serious vein this time.
ex.zh: 這次他說話的語氣嚴肅多了。

vein.en: a style or mood in which something is said or written

ex.en: The wind reached a velocity of 150 kilometers per hour.
ex.zh: 風速達到每小時 150 公里。

ex.en: Light travels at a constant velocity.
ex.zh: 光以固定的速度前進。

velocity.en: the speed at which something moves in a certain direction

ex.en: She's vegetarian, so she ate tofu instead of turkey.
ex.zh: 她是素食者，所以她沒吃火雞，而是吃了豆腐。

ex.en: Tom and I are both vegetarians.
ex.zh: 我和湯姆都吃素。

ex.en: Tom's new girlfriend is a vegetarian.
ex.zh: 湯姆的新女朋友吃素。

vegetarian.en: a person who does not eat meat or fish

ex.en: Can you recommend any vegetarian dishes?
ex.zh: 可以推薦幾道素食料理嗎？

ex.en: Do you have vegetarian pilaf?
ex.zh: 你們有素的手抓飯嗎？

vegetarian.en: not containing meat or fish, or eating no meat or fish

ex.en: His constant lateness vexed his boss.
ex.zh: 他老是遲到，讓老闆很惱火。

ex.en: It vexes me that nobody listens to my advice.
ex.zh: 沒有人聽我的建議，讓我很氣惱。

vex.en: to make someone feel annoyed or worried

ex.en: Mary took her dog to the vet.
ex.zh: 瑪莉帶她的狗去看獸醫。

ex.en: We took our cat to the vet for a vaccination.
ex.zh: 我們帶貓去獸醫那裡打預防針。

ex.en: The vet said my dog needs to lose some weight.
ex.zh: 獸醫說我的狗需要減肥。

vet.en: a doctor who treats sick or hurt animals

ex.en: I can verify that that's the truth myself.
ex.zh: 我可以親自證實那是真的。

ex.en: Concerning the content below, I want to verify two things.
ex.zh: 關於以下內容，我想確認兩件事。

verify.en: to check or prove that something is true or correct

ex.en: The jury's guilty verdict gave rise to widespread debate.
ex.zh: 陪審團的有罪判決引發了廣泛的爭論。

ex.en: The jury will announce its verdict tomorrow.
ex.zh: 陪審團明天將宣布判決。

verdict.en: an official decision made by a court about whether someone is guilty

ex.en: What's your verdict on the new restaurant?
ex.zh: 你覺得那家新餐廳怎麼樣？

ex.en: The verdict from the critics was positive.
ex.zh: 評論家的評價是正面的。

verdict.en: an opinion or decision about something after thinking about it

ex.en: Our venue wasn't renovated too long ago.
ex.zh: 我們的場地不久前才翻新過。

ex.en: Inside the venue, sounds of clapping, whistling, yelling, laughing blended together.
ex.zh: 會場裡，鼓掌聲、口哨聲、喊叫聲和笑聲混成一片。

venue.en: a place where an event, such as a concert or match, takes place

ex.en: The ventilation here is really bad.
ex.zh: 這裡的通風很差呢。

ex.en: This room has fine ventilation.
ex.zh: 這房間的通風裝置很好。

ex.en: The ventilation system needs regular maintenance.
ex.zh: 通風系統需要定期保養。

ex.en: Better ventilation will improve the air quality.
ex.zh: 改善通風能提升空氣品質。

ventilation.en: the way fresh air moves through a room, or the system that makes it do so

ex.en: The startup raised venture capital from two firms.
ex.zh: 這家新創公司向兩家公司募得創業投資。

ex.en: Venture capital helped fund the product launch.
ex.zh: 創業投資協助支付產品上市所需資金。

venture capital.en: money invested in new businesses that may be risky but could make a lot of profit

ex.en: The bank requires verification of your identity.
ex.zh: 銀行要求查證你的身分。

ex.en: Email verification is needed to activate the account.
ex.zh: 必須完成電子郵件驗證才能啟用帳戶。

verification.en: the act of checking that something is true or correct

ex.en: The restaurant labels every dish suitable for a vegan.
ex.zh: 餐廳標示出每道適合純素者的餐點。

ex.en: As a vegan, he checks ingredient lists for hidden dairy.
ex.zh: 身為純素者，他會檢查成分表是否含有隱藏的乳製品。

vegan.en: a person who does not eat or use any animal products

ex.en: Ali's grandfather is a tea vendor.
ex.zh: 阿里的祖父是賣茶的小販。

ex.en: The street vendor sells fried chicken.
ex.zh: 那個路邊攤販賣炸雞。

vendor.en: a person who sells things, usually food, on the street

ex.en: We work with several software vendors.
ex.zh: 我們跟好幾家軟體廠商合作。

ex.en: The vendor will deliver the equipment next week.
ex.zh: 廠商下週會送來設備。

vendor.en: a company that sells goods or services to other businesses

ex.en: Tonight's game is Taiwan versus Japan.
ex.zh: 今晚的比賽是台灣對日本。

ex.en: It's a case of quality versus price.
ex.zh: 這是品質與價格之間的取捨。

ex.en: Let's compare working from home versus working in the office.
ex.zh: 我們來比較在家工作與在辦公室工作。

ex.en: He wrote a short poem in verse for her birthday.
ex.zh: 他為她的生日寫了一首短詩。

ex.en: Children enjoy stories told in simple verse.
ex.zh: 孩子們喜歡用簡單韻文說的故事。

verse.zh: 詩節、（歌曲的）段落；聖經的節

ex.en: We sang the first verse of the song together.
ex.zh: 我們一起唱了這首歌的第一段。

ex.en: She read a verse from the Bible aloud.
ex.zh: 她大聲朗讀一節聖經經文。

ex.en: Venice is an Italian city built on many small islands.
ex.zh: 威尼斯是建立在許多小島上的義大利城市。

ex.en: Boats called gondolas carry visitors along the canals of Venice.
ex.zh: 名為貢多拉的小船載著遊客穿梭在威尼斯的運河間。

ex.en: The chair was covered in soft red velvet.
ex.zh: 那張椅子包著柔軟的紅色絲絨。

ex.en: She wore a dress made of black velvet.
ex.zh: 她穿著一件黑色絲絨做的洋裝。

ex.en: The curtains of the old theater were made of velvet.
ex.zh: 老戲院的窗簾是絲絨做的。

ex.en: The cat has a velvet coat that feels very soft.
ex.zh: 那隻貓有一身摸起來很柔軟的絲絨般毛皮。

ex.en: She spoke in a velvet voice that calmed the children.
ex.zh: 她用柔滑的聲音說話，讓孩子們平靜下來。

ex.en: The company is on the verge of closing down.
ex.zh: 這家公司瀕臨倒閉。

ex.en: She was on the verge of tears when she heard the news.
ex.zh: 聽到消息時，她幾乎要哭出來了。

ex.en: His confidence verges on arrogance.
ex.zh: 他的自信近乎傲慢。

ex.en: The noise verged on unbearable.
ex.zh: 那噪音幾乎到了讓人無法忍受的地步。

ex.en: The bride wore a white veil over her face.
ex.zh: 新娘臉上蓋著白色面紗。

ex.en: A thin veil of mist covered the valley.
ex.zh: 一層薄薄的霧幕籠罩著山谷。

ex.en: Dark clouds veiled the moon last night.
ex.zh: 昨晚烏雲遮住了月亮。

ex.en: He tried to veil his disappointment with a smile.
ex.zh: 他試著用微笑掩飾自己的失望。

ex.en: She is studying veterinary medicine.
ex.zh: 她正在學獸醫學。

ex.en: We took the cat to a veterinary clinic.
ex.zh: 我們帶貓去獸醫診所。

ex.en: Warm air blew out of the vent near the floor.
ex.zh: 暖風從靠近地板的通風口吹出來。

ex.en: Open the vent to let the steam escape.
ex.zh: 把排氣口打開讓蒸氣散出去。

ex.en: She called her friend to vent about her bad day.
ex.zh: 她打電話給朋友發洩糟糕一天的情緒。

ex.en: He vented his anger by going for a long run.
ex.zh: 他靠長跑來發洩怒氣。

ex.en: He swore to take vengeance on those who hurt his family.
ex.zh: 他發誓要向傷害他家人的人報仇。

ex.en: The film is about a man seeking vengeance for his brother.
ex.zh: 這部電影講的是一個為弟弟尋求復仇的男人。

ex.en: She felt no desire for vengeance, only sadness.
ex.zh: 她沒有報復的念頭，只有悲傷。

ex.en: The car veered off the road to avoid a dog.
ex.zh: 那輛車為了閃避一隻狗而突然駛離道路。

ex.en: The wind veered to the north during the night.
ex.zh: 風在夜裡轉向了北方。

ex.en: The conversation veered toward politics after dinner.
ex.zh: 晚餐後話題突然轉到了政治上。

versatile.zh: 多才多藝的；用途廣泛的

ex.en: She is a versatile actress who can play any role.
ex.zh: 她是個多才多藝的演員，什麼角色都能演。

ex.en: A good knife is a versatile tool in any kitchen.
ex.zh: 一把好刀是任何廚房裡用途廣泛的工具。

ex.en: This versatile jacket works for both rain and cold weather.
ex.zh: 這件多用途外套雨天和冷天都能穿。

ex.en: Venus is the brightest planet in the evening sky.
ex.zh: 金星是傍晚天空中最亮的行星。

ex.en: Venus is the second planet from the sun.
ex.zh: 金星是離太陽第二近的行星。

venus.zh: 維納斯（羅馬神話中的愛與美之神）

ex.en: In Roman myth, Venus is the goddess of love and beauty.
ex.zh: 在羅馬神話中，維納斯是愛與美的女神。

ex.en: The museum has a famous statue of Venus.
ex.zh: 這間博物館有一座著名的維納斯雕像。

ex.en: Hold the paper vertically and fold it in half.
ex.zh: 把紙直著拿，然後對折。

ex.en: The rocket rose vertically into the sky.
ex.zh: 火箭垂直升向天空。

ex.en: You can stack the boxes vertically to save space.
ex.zh: 你可以把箱子往上疊來節省空間。

venerable.zh: 德高望重的、年高受敬重的

ex.en: The venerable professor has taught at the school for fifty years.
ex.zh: 這位德高望重的教授在這所學校任教五十年了。

ex.en: They visited a venerable old temple in the mountains.
ex.zh: 他們造訪了山中一座古老而受人敬重的寺廟。

ex.en: We bought a Venetian mask at the market.
ex.zh: 我們在市集買了一個威尼斯面具。

ex.en: The hotel has a Venetian style garden.
ex.zh: 這家飯店有一座威尼斯風格的花園。

ex.en: The Venetians built their city on small islands.
ex.zh: 威尼斯人把城市建在許多小島上。

ex.en: A Venetian taught us how to row a gondola.
ex.zh: 一位威尼斯人教我們怎麼划貢多拉。

ex.en: Venezuela is a country in South America.
ex.zh: 委內瑞拉是南美洲的一個國家。

ex.en: Caracas is the capital of Venezuela.
ex.zh: 卡拉卡斯是委內瑞拉的首都。

ex.en: Eat your veggies before you have dessert.
ex.zh: 先把蔬菜吃完才能吃甜點。

ex.en: She chopped some veggies for the soup.
ex.zh: 她切了一些蔬菜來煮湯。

ex.en: My cousin is a veggie, so we ordered a meat-free menu.
ex.zh: 我表弟是素食者，所以我們點了不含肉的餐點。

ex.en: The restaurant has a special menu for veggies.
ex.zh: 這家餐廳有給素食者的特別菜單。

ex.en: The veterinarian checked our dog and gave him a shot.
ex.zh: 獸醫檢查了我們的狗並幫牠打了一針。

ex.en: She wants to become a veterinarian because she loves animals.
ex.zh: 她想當獸醫，因為她愛動物。

ex.en: He has a vested interest in the success of the company.
ex.zh: 他在公司的成功中有切身利益。

ex.en: The employees became fully vested in the plan after five years.
ex.zh: 員工在五年後完全取得該計畫的既得權益。

ex.en: He verbally agreed to the deal, but nothing was written down.
ex.zh: 他口頭上同意了這筆交易，但沒有留下書面紀錄。

ex.en: Students were verbally warned not to run in the hall.
ex.zh: 學生被口頭警告不要在走廊奔跑。

ex.en: The venom of this snake can be very dangerous.
ex.zh: 這種蛇的毒液可能非常危險。

ex.en: Doctors gave him medicine to fight the venom.
ex.zh: 醫生給他藥物來對抗毒液。

ex.en: She spoke with venom about her old boss.
ex.zh: 她用充滿怨毒的語氣談論她的前老闆。

ex.en: His words were full of venom.
ex.zh: 他的話充滿惡意。

ex.en: This tool is popular because of its versatility.
ex.zh: 這個工具因為用途多而很受歡迎。

ex.en: The actor showed great versatility by playing both comic and serious roles.
ex.zh: 那位演員同時演出喜劇和嚴肅的角色，展現了多才多藝。

ex.en: Rice's versatility makes it a staple in many cuisines.
ex.zh: 米的用途多元，讓它成為許多料理的主食。

ex.en: The restaurant serves roast veal with vegetables.
ex.zh: 這家餐廳供應搭配蔬菜的烤小牛肉。

ex.en: Veal is the meat of young calves.
ex.zh: 小牛肉指的是幼牛的肉。

ex.en: Only a few vestiges of the old wall remain.
ex.zh: 舊城牆只剩下少數遺跡。

ex.en: The ruins are a vestige of an ancient civilization.
ex.zh: 這些廢墟是古文明的遺跡。

ex.en: There was not a vestige of doubt in her mind.
ex.zh: 她心中沒有一絲懷疑。

ex.en: He kept a vestige of hope until the end.
ex.zh: 他到最後仍保有一絲希望。

ex.en: The garden was a veritable paradise for birds.
ex.zh: 這座花園簡直就是鳥兒的天堂。

ex.en: She is a veritable genius when it comes to math.
ex.zh: 在數學方面，她可說是名副其實的天才。

ex.en: He vehemently denied taking the money.
ex.zh: 他強烈否認拿了那筆錢。

ex.en: The neighbors vehemently opposed the new road.
ex.zh: 鄰居們強烈反對這條新路。

ex.en: The table is made of cheap wood with an oak veneer.
ex.zh: 這張桌子是便宜木材貼上橡木飾面薄板。

ex.en: The veneer is starting to peel at the corner.
ex.zh: 飾面薄板在轉角處開始剝落。

ex.en: His polite manner was only a thin veneer of kindness.
ex.zh: 他的客氣只是一層薄薄的善意假象。

ex.en: Behind the veneer of calm, she was very nervous.
ex.zh: 在鎮定的外表下，她其實非常緊張。

ex.en: We drank tea on the veranda in the evening.
ex.zh: 我們傍晚在門廊上喝茶。

ex.en: The house has a wide veranda facing the garden.
ex.zh: 這棟房子有一個面向花園的寬敞陽台。

ex.en: Nobody doubted the verity of her statement.
ex.zh: 沒有人懷疑她的說法是否屬實。

ex.en: The scientists tested the verity of the old theory.
ex.zh: 科學家檢驗了那個舊理論是否為真。

ex.en: Standing on the high bridge gave him vertigo.
ex.zh: 站在高高的橋上讓他頭暈目眩。

ex.en: She suffers from vertigo and avoids tall buildings.
ex.zh: 她有眩暈症，所以避開高樓。

ex.en: The doctor said a vertebra in his back was damaged.
ex.zh: 醫生說他背部有一節脊椎骨受傷。

ex.en: Each vertebra protects part of the spinal cord.
ex.zh: 每一節脊椎骨保護脊髓的一部分。

ex.en: She cooked a traditional Venezuelan dish for dinner.
ex.zh: 她晚餐煮了一道傳統的委內瑞拉菜。

ex.en: The Venezuelan coast has many beautiful beaches.
ex.zh: 委內瑞拉的海岸有許多美麗的海灘。

ex.en: A veiled woman walked into the hall.
ex.zh: 一位蒙著面紗的女士走進大廳。

ex.en: He made a veiled threat during the meeting.
ex.zh: 他在會議中說了一句暗藏威脅的話。

ex.en: Please leave your wet shoes in the vestibule before coming in.
ex.zh: 進來之前，請把濕鞋子留在門廳。

ex.en: The hotel vestibule was warm and lit by a small chandelier.
ex.zh: 飯店的前廳溫暖，由一盞小吊燈照亮。

vegas.zh: 維加斯（常指美國拉斯維加斯）

ex.en: Many tourists fly to Vegas for the shows and hotels.
ex.zh: 許多遊客飛到維加斯看表演、住飯店。

ex.en: Vegas is in the state of Nevada, in the desert.
ex.zh: 維加斯位於內華達州的沙漠中。

ex.en: The patient was placed on a ventilator to help him breathe.
ex.zh: 病人被接上呼吸器幫助呼吸。

ex.en: The hospital bought more ventilators for its intensive care unit.
ex.zh: 醫院為加護病房增購了更多呼吸器。

ex.en: Turn on the ventilator to get rid of the cooking smell.
ex.zh: 打開換氣扇把煮菜的味道排掉。

ex.en: The small bathroom has a ventilator in the ceiling.
ex.zh: 那間小浴室的天花板上有一個通風扇。

ex.en: We drank tea on the verandah and watched the rain.
ex.zh: 我們在陽臺上喝茶，看著雨景。

ex.en: The old house has a wide verandah running along the front.
ex.zh: 這棟老房子正面有一條寬敞的長廊陽臺。

ex.en: The book was written in the vernacular so ordinary people could read it.
ex.zh: 這本書用日常口語寫成，讓一般人也能讀懂。

ex.en: She switched to the local vernacular when she talked with the villagers.
ex.zh: 她和村民交談時改用當地的方言。

ex.en: The architect studied the vernacular style of houses in the region.
ex.zh: 建築師研究了這個地區的傳統民居風格。

ex.en: Vernacular languages are often used in daily life, not in formal writing.
ex.zh: 本土語言常用於日常生活，而不是正式書寫。

vestry.zh: 教堂聖器室；教區委員會

ex.en: The priest put on his robe in the vestry.
ex.zh: 神父在聖器室裡穿上長袍。

ex.en: The vestry met on Sunday to plan the church repairs.
ex.zh: 教區委員會週日開會討論教堂修繕。

ex.en: The seeds are in their vegetative stage of growth.
ex.zh: 這些種子正處於植物的營養生長階段。

ex.en: Some plants spread by vegetative reproduction, like potatoes.
ex.zh: 有些植物像馬鈴薯一樣靠無性繁殖擴散。

ex.en: I always eat some veg with my dinner.
ex.zh: 我晚餐總是會吃一些蔬菜。

ex.en: The shop sells fresh fruit and veg every day.
ex.zh: 這家店每天都賣新鮮的水果和蔬菜。

ex.en: We had roast venison with potatoes for dinner.
ex.zh: 我們晚餐吃了烤鹿肉配馬鈴薯。

ex.en: Venison is leaner than beef.
ex.zh: 鹿肉比牛肉更瘦。

ex.en: The soup had a smooth, velvety texture.
ex.zh: 這道湯的口感滑順如天鵝絨。

ex.en: The petals of the rose were soft and velvety.
ex.zh: 玫瑰花瓣柔軟如天鵝絨。

ex.en: A fish is a vertebrate with a backbone.
ex.zh: 魚是有脊椎的脊椎動物。

ex.en: Birds and mammals are both vertebrates.
ex.zh: 鳥類和哺乳類都是脊椎動物。

ex.en: Humans are vertebrate animals.
ex.zh: 人類是有脊椎的動物。

ex.en: The class studied vertebrate anatomy this week.
ex.zh: 這堂課這週學的是脊椎動物的解剖構造。

ex.en: The police checked the veracity of his story.
ex.zh: 警方查證了他說法的真實性。

ex.en: I doubt the veracity of that news report.
ex.zh: 我懷疑那則新聞報導的真實性。

ex.en: Everyone trusted her because of her veracity.
ex.zh: 大家都因為她的誠實而信任她。

ex.en: The nurse drew a venous blood sample from his arm.
ex.zh: 護理師從他的手臂抽取靜脈血液樣本。

ex.en: Venous blood carries blood back to the heart.
ex.zh: 靜脈血把血液送回心臟。

verdun.zh: （地名）凡爾登，法國東北部城市

ex.en: Verdun is a city in northeastern France.
ex.zh: 凡爾登是法國東北部的一座城市。

ex.en: Many visitors travel to Verdun to see the old battlefields.
ex.zh: 許多遊客前往凡爾登參觀舊戰場。

ex.en: The vengeful king ordered his enemies to be hunted down.
ex.zh: 那位報復心重的國王下令追捕他的敵人。

ex.en: She felt vengeful after being treated so unfairly.
ex.zh: 受到如此不公平的對待後，她心中充滿報復之念。

ex.en: We hiked through verdant hills in spring.
ex.zh: 春天時我們健行穿越青翠的山丘。

ex.en: The valley was green and verdant after the rain.
ex.zh: 雨後山谷一片翠綠。

ex.en: He gave a vehement denial of the rumor.
ex.zh: 他對這個謠言作出強烈的否認。

ex.en: There was vehement opposition to the new tax.
ex.zh: 新稅制遭到激烈反對。

ex.en: She was vexed that nobody had called her back.
ex.zh: 沒有人回她電話，讓她很惱火。

ex.en: The vexed question of who should pay is still not settled.
ex.zh: 到底該由誰付錢這個棘手的問題還沒解決。

ex.en: The two families had a vendetta that lasted for generations.
ex.zh: 這兩個家族的世仇延續了好幾代。

ex.en: He felt the boss had a personal vendetta against him.
ex.zh: 他覺得老闆對他懷有私人恩怨。

ex.en: Open the windows to ventilate the room.
ex.zh: 打開窗戶讓房間通風。

ex.en: The kitchen is well ventilated.
ex.zh: 這個廚房通風良好。

ex.en: The meeting gave workers a chance to ventilate their concerns.
ex.zh: 這場會議讓員工有機會表達他們的擔憂。

ex.en: He ventilated his anger by writing a letter.
ex.zh: 他靠寫信宣洩怒氣。

ex.en: The news report must be based on verifiable facts.
ex.zh: 新聞報導必須以可查證的事實為基礎。

ex.en: There is no verifiable evidence for his claim.
ex.zh: 他的說法沒有可查證的證據。

ex.en: The farmer set traps to keep vermin out of the barn.
ex.zh: 農夫設下陷阱，防止害蟲進入穀倉。

ex.en: Rats and other vermin lived in the old warehouse.
ex.zh: 老鼠和其他害蟲住在那間舊倉庫裡。

ex.en: There is a vending machine near the school gate.
ex.zh: 學校大門附近有一台自動販賣機。

ex.en: The vending business grew quickly in the city.
ex.zh: 這座城市的自動販賣事業成長得很快。

ex.en: Some snakes in this forest are venomous.
ex.zh: 這座森林裡有些蛇是有毒的。

ex.en: A venomous spider bit him on the hand.
ex.zh: 一隻毒蜘蛛咬了他的手。
